responsibility: Implements Tree SSA address decomposition and reconstruction around TARGET_MEM_REF and MEM_REF, bridging GIMPLE-level address arithmetic with target addressing capabilities. It owns the routines that split references into symbol/base/index/step/offset parts, build or validate target addresses via RTL address modes, fold and canonicalize TARGET_MEM_REFs, create memory-reference trees from affine forms, and transfer alias, points-to, dependence-clique, and alignment metadata when references are rewritten; this is the tree-SSA utility layer used by IV optimizers and other passes that reason about address costs and legal addressing forms.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file for the tree-SSA address utilities: it contains the executable logic for decomposing, validating, folding, and rebuilding MEM_REF/TARGET_MEM_REF addresses, including target-specific RTL address-cost and legality checks. In contrast, gcc/tree-ssa-address.h only defines the mem_address data structure and declares that interface for other passes.
